efteling.name: Efteling
efteling.slogan: A fairy-tale forest drawn by hand, still growing since 1952.
efteling.line: Designed by Anton Pieck, the Fairy Tale Forest opened in 1952 with about ten tales; it now has 30.

grotekerktoren.name: Grote Kerk Tower
grotekerktoren.slogan: 97 metres of Brabant Gothic above Breda's rooftops.
grotekerktoren.line: The current tower rose between 1468 and 1509, after its predecessor collapsed in 1457.

spanjaardsgat.name: Spanjaardsgat
spanjaardsgat.slogan: The water gate that remembers a boat full of soldiers.
spanjaardsgat.line: In 1590, about 70 soldiers hidden in a peat barge slipped into Breda and took the castle.

vangoghhuiszundert.name: Van Gogh House, Zundert
vangoghhuiszundert.slogan: Where a vicar's son first looked at the Brabant fields.
vangoghhuiszundert.line: Vincent was born in the parsonage here on 30 March 1853, a year to the day after a stillborn brother also named Vincent.

depont.name: De Pont
depont.slogan: A mirror in a textile mill that tips the sky upside down.
depont.line: Kapoor's Sky Mirror in Tilburg is 6.5 metres wide, a rectangular sibling of the dish in Nottingham.
